claim: Mannheim Steamroller is derived from the technique known as Mannheim rocket.
evidence_a: The name “Mannheim Steamroller” comes from an 18th-century German musical technique, Mannheim rocket ( German: Mannheimer Walze ), a crescendo passage having a rising melodic line over an ostinato bass line, popularized by the Mannheim school of composition.
evidence_b: The name “Mannheim Steamroller” comes from an 18th-century German musical technique, Mannheim roller ( German: Mannheimer Walze ), a crescendo passage having a rising melodic line over an ostinato bass line, popularized by the Mannheim school of composition.
